title: FLUX 2 Dev
description: Black Forest Labs FLUX 2 Dev — next-generation FLUX quality with multi-reference image editing (up to 4 reference images) and seed control.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate.

reference_images.description: Optional reference images (up to 4) for image editing and multi-reference composition. Each item is a public image URL, a data URI, raw base64, or an uploaded-file URL from POST /v1/uploads. Omit for text-to-image.

seed.description: Seed for reproducible generation. Omit for random.
